note: Sentences the TriggerSemanticsReader must decide or must decline. Kept as their own file so the reader's contract is falsifiable independently of the corpora that happen to contain triggers.

cases.text: buy VOO when SPY crosses below its 200-day moving average
buy VOO while SPY stays below its 200-day moving average
buy VOO when SPY crosses below and stays below its 200-day moving average
cases.why: both readings are present; picking one is a guess

cases.text: buy VOO when SPY does not fall below its 200-day moving average
cases.why: negation inverts the condition and the reader has no rule for it

cases.text: buy VOO and sell BND when SPY falls below its 200-day moving average
cases.why: a coordinated action clause does not change the trigger

cases.text: buy VOO when QQQ falls below its 200-day moving average
cases.why: held and observed instruments differ; the trigger is unaffected
